mapper.sql: article_id, title, tag_name, author, published_time, tag_id, content, star, collection, comment, share, page_view, stick
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_article (title, tag_name, author, published_time, tag_id, content, stick) VALUES (#{title}, #{tagName}, #{authorId}, NOW(), #{tagId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.published_time, a.tag_name, a.author, a.share, a.star, a.comment, a.collection, SUBSTRING(a.content, 1, 200) as content, a.stick, a.page_view FROM a_article a ORDER BY a.stick DESC, a.published_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT article_id, title, published_time, tag_name, author, share, star, comment, collection, SUBSTRING(content, 1, 200) as content, stick, page_view FROM a_article WHERE author = #{authorId} ORDER BY published_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a_article WHERE author = #{authorId}

SELECT article_id, title, published_time, tag_name, author, share, star, comment, collection, SUBSTRING(content, 1, 200) as content, stick, page_view FROM a_article WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchContent}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchContent}, '%') ORDER BY published_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a_article WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchContent}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchContent}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE a_article SET star = star + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET collection = collection + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET comment = comment + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET share = share + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET page_view = page_view + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.published_time, a.tag_name, a.author, a.share, a.star, a.comment, a.collection, SUBSTRING(a.content, 1, 200) as content, a.stick, a.page_view FROM a_article a INNER JOIN a_collection c ON a.article_id = c.article_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.collection_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a_collection WHERE user_id = #{userId}
